description: Compare the food-hygiene profile of two or more UK cities / local authorities side by side — average rating, % of 5-star premises, % of low-rated premises and total establishments — and rank them cleanest-first. Useful for "is it safer to eat out in Leeds or Manchester?". Note: Scotland (FHIS) authorities have no star average and are ranked by their Pass rate where comparable.

authorities.description: Two to eight city / local-authority names, e.g. ["Birmingham", "Leeds", "Bristol"].

name: compare_city_hygiene
title: Compare food-hygiene across UK cities
